title: Sassy Chicken Enchilada Dip
description: Zesty Southwest flavorings make this creamy chicken dip as unique as it is delicious. Serve with tortilla chips.
ingredients: 3 cooked, boneless chicken breast halves, shredded
2 (8 ounce) packages light cream cheese, softened
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers

steps.text: In a bowl, mix the shredded chicken, light cream cheese, green onions, diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, garlic, and cilantro. Season with chili powder, cumin, oregano, and paprika. Cover, and chill at least 2 hours.

video.description: Shake up chip dip expectations with this spicy, creamy and meat-filled mix that’s perfect for smothering crispy tortilla chips. And it couldn’t be easier to whip up—simply mix shredded chicken with cream cheese, green onions, diced tomatoes and green chiles, garlic and cilantro. Season it right with chili powder, cumin, oregano and paprika. When you’ve given this Mexican-flavored dip a good chill to blend flavors, serve it surrounded with your favorite snacking chips and delight the crowd!
